content.title: Ashford Hospitality Trust: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: DALLAS (AP) — Ashford Hospitality Trust Inc. (AHT) on Wednesday reported a key measure of profitability in its second quarter, after reporting a loss in the same period a year earlier.  The real estate investment trust, based in Dallas, said it had funds from operations of $4.6 million, or 78 cents per share, in the period.  Funds from operations is a closely watched measure in the REIT industry.
